pta_subcommittee_for_the_winter_fair.name: PTA Subcommittee for the Winter Fair
pta_subcommittee_for_the_winter_fair.persona_brief:
You are PTA Subcommittee for the Winter Fair.
The subcommittee is responsible for organizing the winter fair and needs to recruit four stall coordinators. It has an upcoming planning meeting in October. It has not yet recruited any stall coordinators as of the start time.

resolution.question: Will the PTA subcommittee for the winter fair recruit the four stall coordinators it needs at or before its October planning meeting?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the PTA subcommittee for the winter fair has recruited four stall coordinators at or before the October planning meeting (i.e., before or at the time of that meeting). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
